us_cities_sf <- st_as_sf(us_cities, coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326)  


eqdc <- "+proj=eqdc +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-96 +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs"
conus_states <- aoi_get(state = "conus")
conus_states_eqdc <- st_transform(conus_states, crs = eqdc)


us_cities_eqdc <- st_transform(us_cities_sf, crs = eqdc)
cities_with_states <- st_join(us_cities_eqdc, conus_states_eqdc)


cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_with_states %>% filter(!is.na(state_name.x)) 
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(units)
library(AOI)


eqdc <- "+proj=eqdc +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-96 +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs"


conus_states <- aoi_get(state = "conus") %>% st_transform(eqdc)
north_america <- aoi_get(country = c("USA", "CA", "MX")) %>% st_transform(eqdc)


us_cities <- read_csv("data/uscities.csv")
Rows: 31254 Columns: 17
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr (9): city, city_ascii, state_id, state_name, county_fips, county_name, s...
dbl (6): lat, lng, population, density, ranking, id
lgl (2): military, incorporated

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
us_cities_sf <- st_as_sf(us_cities, coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>% 
  st_transform(eqdc)


cities_with_states <- st_join(us_cities_sf, conus_states)
cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_with_states %>% filter(!is.na(state_name.x))  

state_borders <- conus_states %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


country_borders <- north_america %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


mexico_border <- north_america %>%
  filter(admin == "Mexico") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


canada_border <- north_america %>%
  filter(admin == "Canada") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  mutate(
    dist_to_national_border = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, country_borders)),
    dist_to_state_border    = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, state_borders)),
    dist_to_mexico          = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, mexico_border)),
    dist_to_canada          = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, canada_border))
  )


us_outline <- conus_states %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")  


cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  mutate(dist_to_us_border = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, us_outline)))


library(flextable)

top5_far_from_border <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  arrange(desc(dist_to_us_border)) %>%
  select(city = state_name.x, state = state_name.x, distance_m = dist_to_us_border) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(distance_km = round(distance_m / 1000, 1)) %>%  
  select(city, state, distance_km)

state_borders_preserved <- conus_states %>%
  st_geometry() %>%            
  st_combine() %>%              
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")   


cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  mutate(dist_to_state_border = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, state_borders_preserved)))


library(flextable)

  arrange(desc(dist_to_state_border)) %>%
  select(city = state_name.x, state = state_name.x, distance_m = dist_to_state_border) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(distance_km = round(distance_m / 1000, 1)) %>%
  select(city, state, distance_km)

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)
library(gghighlight)

top_10_cities_sf <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  arrange(desc(population)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)


cities_conus_eqdc <- st_transform(cities_conus_eqdc, st_crs(conus_states))


combined_state_borders <- st_combine(conus_states) %>% st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>% st_make_valid()


cities_conus_eqdc <- st_make_valid(cities_conus_eqdc)


cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  mutate(dist_to_national_border = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, combined_state_borders)))


farthest_cities <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  slice_max(dist_to_national_border, n = 5)


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = north_america, fill = "lightgray", color = "black", lwd = 0.5) +  
  geom_sf(data = conus_states, fill = "transparent", color = "blue", lty = "dashed", lwd = 0.5) +  
  geom_sf(data = cities_conus_eqdc, aes(color = dist_to_national_border), size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "yellow") +  
  geom_label_repel(data = farthest_cities, 
                   aes(geometry = geometry, label = state_name.x),
                   stat = "sf_coordinates",
                   box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 1, max.overlaps = 10) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "USA Cities Colored by Distance from National Border",
    subtitle = "Top 5 Farthest Cities Labeled",
    color = "Distance (m)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)


state_borders_multiline <- conus_states %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_sf(geometry = .)

cities_conus_eqdc <- st_transform(cities_conus_eqdc, st_crs(state_borders_multiline))

cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  mutate(dist_to_state_border = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, state_borders_multiline)))

farthest_cities_state <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  slice_max(dist_to_state_border, n = 5)


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = conus_states, fill = "white", color = "black", lwd = 0.3) +
  
  
  geom_sf(data = cities_conus_eqdc, aes(color = dist_to_state_border), size = 2) +
  
  
  geom_label_repel(data = farthest_cities_state,
                   aes(label = state_name.x, geometry = geometry),
                   stat = "sf_coordinates",
                   min.segment.length = 0,
                   box.padding = 0.5, 
                   max.overlaps = 10) +
  
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Distance to State Border (m)") +
  labs(title = "Distance of US Cities to Nearest State Border",
       subtitle = "Top 5 Cities Farthest from Any State Border Highlighted") +
  theme_minimal()
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)


cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  mutate(dist_diff_mex_can = abs(dist_to_mexico - dist_to_canada))


equidistant_cities <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  filter(dist_diff_mex_can <= 100000)


top_5_equidistant <- equidistant_cities %>%
  slice_max(order_by = population, n = 5)


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = conus_states, fill = "white", color = "gray70", size = 0.3) +
  
  
  geom_sf(data = cities_conus_eqdc, color = "lightgray", size = 0.5) +
  
  
  geom_sf(data = equidistant_cities, aes(color = dist_diff_mex_can), size = 2) +
  
  
  geom_label_repel(
    data = top_5_equidistant,
    aes(label = state_name.x, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = 10,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Dist Diff (m)", option = "C") +
  labs(
    title = "Cities Equidistant (~100 km) from Mexican & Canadian Borders",
    subtitle = "Top 5 Most Populous Cities in this Zone"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
